_comment: Attribute names and tooltips from the Game Mechanics doc. Spell power, crit, cast speed and resource size are computed by CombatStats in res://systems/combat/; progression only owns health, which depends on level.

strength.name: Strength
strength.tooltip: +1% force damage, +0.5% stagger resistance and further knockback per point. Unlocks heavy staves and warded robes.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.tooltip: +5 health and +0.1 health per second per point. Sorcerer: +1% spell power and +1 strain capacity per 2 points.

dexterity.name: Dexterity
dexterity.tooltip: +0.5% cast speed, +0.3% critical chance and -0.5% Blink cooldown per point. Unlocks wands, light boots and rings of speed.

intelligence.name: Intelligence
intelligence.tooltip: +2 maximum resource and +1% critical damage per point. Mage: +1% spell power. Wizard: +1 prepared spell per 25 points.

wisdom.name: Wisdom
wisdom.tooltip: +1% resource regeneration and +0.3% to all resistances per point. Wizard: +1% cast speed and interrupt resistance. Mage: fewer misfires.
